# Invalid or ambiguous gh-stack state fails closed.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-08-06T12:45:00Z'

mkdir repo
cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Initial commit'
gs repo init
git branch layer
git checkout layer

# Unknown schemas must not be guessed.
env GH_STACK_JSON={"schemaVersion":2,"stacks":[{"trunk":{"branch":"main"},"branches":[{"branch":"layer","base":""}]}]}
exec sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "$GH_STACK_JSON" > .git/gh-stack'
! gs log short
stderr 'unsupported gh-stack state schema version 2'

# A branch cannot belong to two local gh-stacks.
env GH_STACK_JSON={"schemaVersion":1,"stacks":[{"trunk":{"branch":"main"},"branches":[{"branch":"layer","base":""}]},{"trunk":{"branch":"main"},"branches":[{"branch":"layer","base":""}]}]}
exec sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "$GH_STACK_JSON" > .git/gh-stack'
! gs log short
stderr 'current branch "layer" belongs to multiple gh-stacks'

# Stored base identities must resolve locally.
env GH_STACK_JSON={"schemaVersion":1,"stacks":[{"trunk":{"branch":"main"},"branches":[{"branch":"layer","base":"deadbeef"}]}]}
exec sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "$GH_STACK_JSON" > .git/gh-stack'
! gs log short
stderr 'resolve gh-stack base for branch "layer"'
